test_cases.intent: No canonical PAT hits, no declared hits, empty pages_c05 mapping.
Canonical PAT hits bind exactly to final span IDs/depths/text; mapping keys equal their c5p94/labels; each licensor is nonempty and names the actual Tibetan licensor.
One actual PAT match omitted from actual_gated_hits.
A declared hit has no byte-exact actual PAT match in final body.
Any mapping key has no actual canonical gated match.
A matched/declared hit lacks its exact mapping key.
Mapping uses c5p93 or another segment label.
Declared label/id does not identify the exact final accepted span.
Declared or regex d=5/7 differs from actual span d.
Declared source match differs from the canonical PAT match.
Declared hit text differs from the final spec/source tuple.
Whitespace-only or generic exception string lacking the actual Tibetan licensor.
Canonical source bytes differ from the proposed predicate_source pin.
Keep complete accepted spans including cls/nul/subword; this check must not replace them with a projected schema.
d1–4 are untouched; canonical PAT handles d5 and d7 and nested-member prefix exactly, with no new heuristic or regex.
Duplicated declared records cannot stand in for a missing match.

schema_binding: Use actual frozen record schema once declared; do not rewrite frozen data to fit invented field names.
